### 2026-10-07 — I installed all the apps needed to start making my Starbie project. I installed Kicad and got my project up. Now I started making the schematic. I have no idea what I was doing at first, but a little

**2h**

I installed all the apps needed to start making my Starbie project. I installed Kicad and got my project up. Now I started making the schematic. I have no idea what I was doing at first, but a little research helped me be able to navigate Kicad on MacOS. It turns out that Kicad on Mac was a lot more inconvenient as you can only access the foot print and symbol libraries using hot keys. I'm genuinely surprised that they didn't include the tabber on the tab like the Linux and Windows version.
